definitions.explanation: Polite term used to refer to another person's child or children. This is the respectful form used when speaking about or to someone else's children.

examples.japanese: お{子|こ}さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何歳|なんさい}→何歳：08390_nansai⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.notes: Polite way to ask about someone's child

examples.japanese: お{子|こ}さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
お{子|こ}さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いらっしゃいます→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.notes: Very polite form using いらっしゃる

examples.japanese: お{子|こ}さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}しています→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What is your child studying at school?

examples.japanese: お{子|こ}さん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧です⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{時|とき}→〜時：03094_toki⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧ずっと⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Children grow up so fast. Your child has gotten much bigger since the last time I saw them.

notes:
お{子|こ}さん is the polite form used when referring to someone else's child. For your own children, use {子供|こども} or うちの{子|こ}.

RELATED TERMS:
- {子供|こども}: neutral term for child/children (can be used for own or others')
- {息子|むすこ}さん: (someone else's) son
- {娘|むすめ}さん: (someone else's) daughter
- うちの{子|こ}: my child (humble)

The お〜さん pattern is common for polite reference to people: お{客|きゃく}さん (customer), お{医者|いしゃ}さん (doctor).
